🎥🎬: Schitt’s Creek (2015)

The wealthy Rose family suddenly loses their entire fortune after their business manager leaves them bankrupt. Forced to give up their luxurious lifestyle, Johnny, Moira and their two adult children, David and Alexis, relocate to a small town they once purchased as a joke: Schitt’s Creek.

Now living in a rundown motel, the family struggles to adjust to a community completely different from the glamorous world they once knew. Their encounters with the town’s eccentric residents lead to awkward situations, hilarious misunderstandings and plenty of family arguments.

As time passes, the Roses slowly begin building relationships, discovering unexpected opportunities and learning what truly matters beyond wealth and social status. What begins as a humiliating fall from luxury becomes an unexpected journey of personal growth, love and family.

source_details.synopsis: Schitt's Creek (stylized as Schitt$ Creek) is a Canadian television sitcom created by Dan Levy and his father, Eugene Levy, consisting of 80 episodes over six seasons, airing on CBC Television from January 13, 2015, to April 7, 2020. Produced by Not a Real Company Productions and the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation, the series follows the formerly wealthy Rose family. After their business manager embezzles the family company, Rose Video, they lose their fortune and move to a motel in the small (fictional) town of Schitt’s Creek, where they must adjust to a very different life.
